page_title: GEN 1-1 EMP | Genoa v Empoli 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Substitution. Francesco Caputo makes way for Stiven Shpendi (Empoli).
90+2' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Milan Badelj (Genoa).
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Genoa force their opponents to concede a corner.
88' The ball goes out of play and Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
87' The referee gives a yellow card to Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa).
83' Substitution. Stefano Sabelli walks off the pitch and George Puscas (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
83' Seydou Fini (Genoa) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just wide of the left post.
80' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Aureliano signals a set piece.
76' Razvan Marin (Empoli) takes a long-range free kick and whips it into the box. The goalkeeper reads it well and leaps high to intercept the ball.
76' The substitution is prepared. Razvan Marin (Empoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Youssef Maleh.
73' Here is a change. Ruslan Malinovsky is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Seydou Fini (Genoa).
73' Substitution. Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa) in, Johan Vasquez out.
72' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar.
71' A cross by Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
69' Empoli take a short corner kick.

67' 1 - 1 Goal! Viktor Kovalenko hands Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
66' It will be a substitution. Berkan Kutlu (Genoa) is ready to enter the pitch as Junior Messias walks off.
66' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to substitute Daniel Maldini and he is replaced by Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli).
65' A substitution has been made. Filippo Ranocchia goes off and Alberto Grassi (Empoli) comes on.
64' Junior Messias (Genoa) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
63' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
61' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
60' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) controls a great pass from Johan Vasquez on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
59' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) takes a short corner kick.
59' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) takes it short.
58' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' The free kick is delivered by Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. Now Empoli have a corner.
56' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Gianluca Aureliano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
52' Half-chance! Mateo Retegui (Genoa) plays a pass into the box, but Etrit Berisha reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for a foul.

47' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is first to the rebound and sends a header goalwards but it's blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
46' The game is over for Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli). Viktor Kovalenko comes on for the second half.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Junior Messias (Genoa) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
45+1' Junior Messias (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
41' Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
40' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.

37' 1 - 0 Nice piece of skill by Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa). He perfectly collected a pass from Milan Badelj and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.

35' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
34' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Gianluca Aureliano signals. A free kick has been awarded to Empoli.
32' Junior Messias (Genoa) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the right post!
31' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but Josep Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:1. The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
26' Junior Messias (Genoa) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
23' A pass from Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is intercepted by Josep Martinez and the move breaks down.
22' Handball! A player from Genoa handled the ball.
20' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
19' Daniel Maldini (Empoli) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles of the left post. Nice run, but poor finish!
19' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
17' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
15' A rebound falls at the feet of Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies well wide of the left post.
14' The ball goes out for a corner. Genoa can continue in their attacking effort.
14' Genoa take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
13' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
11' Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) tackles a bit over-zealously and Gianluca Aureliano blows for a foul.

7' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Empoli are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

4' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal.
2' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the right post.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Aureliano is the one to supervise the game today.
